causal_sequence: Low soil organic carbon (<0.6%) impairs macro-aggregate stability and reduces soil water retention capacity
Low rainfall combined with poor water holding capacity intensifies root-zone moisture deficit and accelerates mycorrhizal die-off
Monoculture cropping eliminates structural diversity, creating acute floral resource bottlenecks and bare soil exposure
Combined stress triggers microclimatic heating, rapid topsoil crusting, and severe collapse of beneficial soil invertebrates and wild pollinators
causal_chains.restoration_synergy: Synergistic intervention: Agroforestry alley cropping with drought-hardy legumes + minimum tillage + organic residue mulching simultaneously elevates SOC, moderates soil temperature, provides nectar highways, and restores hydraulic lift.

causal_sequence: Elevated agrochemical or industrial runoff introduces chemical toxicity into surface aquifers and soil profiles
Homogeneous landscapes lack vegetative buffer buffers, allowing unattenuated contaminant plume dispersion into critical microhabitats
Direct toxicity coupled with loss of ecological refugia drives rapid extirpation of sensitive macroinvertebrates, amphibians, and wild bees
causal_chains.restoration_synergy: Synergistic intervention: Multi-tier riparian buffer bio-filters + pesticide exclusion zones + native hedgerow corridors to capture runoff and reconnect breeding habitat.

causal_sequence: Canopy removal eliminates vegetative shade and rainfall interception, elevating surface soil temperatures by 4-8°C
Intense heat accelerates microbial decomposition of residual soil humus without replenishing leaf litter
Desiccated topsoils form hydrophobic crusts that repel sporadic torrential rains, driving severe gully erosion and preventing spontaneous seedling germination
causal_chains.restoration_synergy: Synergistic intervention: Assisted Natural Regeneration (ANR) + contour bunds / micro-catchments + pioneer nitrogen-fixing shelterbelts to restore microclimate and break the desertification loop.

causal_sequence: Soil pH below 5.5 triggers phytotoxic Al3+ mobilization and precipitates active phosphorus compounds
Low organic carbon provides inadequate buffering capacity to sequester free heavy metal ions or foster saprophytic fungi
Root stunted crops and native plants fail to develop symbiosis with Rhizobia, leading to depauperate aboveground and belowground food webs
causal_chains.restoration_synergy: Synergistic intervention: Biochar and humic compost amendment + targeted dolomitic calcification + acid-tolerant mycorrhizal fungal inoculants.
